lines.text: Crowds drift between colourful stalls piled with fruit under striped awnings.
@sai_front weaves through the crowd and stops at a mango stall.
@sai_front holds up a ripe mango, turning it in the light.
Sweetest ones in the whole market.
The stallholder grins and nods toward the pile.
@sai_front hands over coins and tucks the mango into a bag.

writes.note: I drafted a short market scene from your line, with one spoken line.

reply.rationale: One location, six short action beats and one six-word line, about 14.4 s by the length rule. Only the listed @sai_front is used.
